notes.text: No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 20 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it, and nor do the unlisted fixes reported since.

No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 20 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it.

Herb Seeds are a bonus from picking herbs, and grow herbs in a Greenhouse at a camp. Blizzard’s 19 Nov hotfixes switched the Seed Hybridizer, which combines seeds, back on: combining now has adjusted values and can fail, and Scarce Herb Seeds can no longer go in.

Since Blizzard’s 10 Nov hotfixes, enchanters need a Runed Golden Rod, made from a Golden Rod, as the tool for crafting the Arcane Salvager camp object. Before, it took a Runed Truesilver Rod. On 19 Nov Blizzard also stopped the Shade of the Archmage vanishing as soon as you fight him; the Camp tab lists him as the source of the Salvager’s blueprint.

Blizzard’s 17 Nov hotfixes made Cultivation, the Tauren racial, work properly on Mageroyal, and its 19 Nov hotfixes made Cultivation more reliable on herbs you have the Herbalism skill for. No hotfix has changed the herb itself.

A rare drop from Windfury Wind Witches in Mulgore (0.07%) and Bloodfeather Harpies in Teldrassil (0.03%). It teaches Minor Frenzy Potion at Alchemy 40, from Earthroot, Silverleaf and an Empty Vial. No hotfix has changed it.

A rare drop from Vile Fin Attackers in Tirisfal Glades (0.62%) and Murloc Foragers in Elwynn Forest (0.03%). It teaches Minor Cleric’s Elixir at Alchemy 45, from 2 Mageroyal, a Bruiseweed and an Empty Vial. No hotfix has changed it.
No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 19 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it.

The smallest Auction House deposit fell from 1 silver to 1 copper with the maintenance on Wed 18 Nov, Wowhead reports. This fish sells to vendors for 5 copper, so every listing of it used to pay the 1 silver minimum, and now costs less. No hotfix has changed the fish itself.
No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 17 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it.
Blizzard cut what vendors pay for it to 5 copper, from 25, on 10 Nov. No hotfix since has changed it.
No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 17 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it.

Dust Stormers and Cyclone Warriors in Silithus, levels 55 to 59, drop it about 4 to 5% of the time, and Alchemists can transmute it from Essence of Water. Forever added recipes that use it, such as Champion’s Legplates, which take 10. No hotfix has changed it.

Waylaid Crates are world drops you fill with materials and hand in for Merchant’s Favor, the currency for Forever’s new recipes, so their price follows demand for Favor. This one takes 10 each of Stranglekelp, Bruiseweed, Wild Steelbloom, Grave Moss and Kingsblood. Blizzard’s 17 Nov hotfixes fixed some crate conversions that gave an obsolete turn-in item.

Waylaid Crates are world drops you fill with materials and hand in for Merchant’s Favor, the currency for Forever’s new recipes, so their price follows demand for Favor and the cost of filling them. Blizzard’s 17 Nov hotfixes fixed some crate conversions that gave an obsolete turn-in item.
Blizzard renamed it Recipe: Elixir of Holy Power on 10 Nov, to match the elixir it teaches, whose buff is now called Holy Power. No hotfix since has changed its drop or use.

New in Forever: 25 Agility and Intellect for 30 minutes, from level 55. Its recipe needs Alchemy 275 and costs 180 Merchant’s Favor at Honored, from Apothecary Durelle in the Barrens or Nina Surefire in Redridge. No hotfix has changed it.

New in Forever. It is smelted from Heavy Thorium Ore at skill 300, at a camp or at special forges in dungeons. The wiki lists 37 Blacksmithing recipes that use it, and 3 Engineering ones. No hotfix has changed it.
New in Forever. A guide based on the beta says it can come from any herb in Mount Hyjal, but only if your gloves have the Lotus Claw enchant. No hotfix has changed it.
It drops from Gnarlpine Mystics in Teldrassil. It teaches Minor Mender’s Potion at Alchemy 30, made from 2 Mageroyal, 1 Bruiseweed and an Empty Vial. No hotfix has changed it.
No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 16 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it.

It drops at about 2 to 3% from earth elementals of level 55 to 59, in Silithus and the Burning Steppes. Forever added 20 new recipes that use it, such as Tailoring’s Earthenweave set, which takes 13 in all. No hotfix has changed it.
New in Forever. Its recipe needs Alchemy 290 and costs 240 Merchant’s Favor. No hotfix has changed it.
In Forever, First Aid makes healing potions instead of Alchemy, so any player can learn this recipe. Greater Healing Potion needed First Aid 155 in the beta. No hotfix has changed it.
No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 13 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it, and nor does any Blizzard post since.
Forever’s new bar, smelted at Mining 275 from 2 Pitchblende and 1 Coal. Pitchblende is a scarce extra from ore nodes. Blacksmiths, Engineers and Enchanters use it. No hotfix has changed it.
Forever’s new herb. The wiki lists just two uses, both endgame Alchemy flasks: Natural Accuracy and Natural Aggression. No hotfix has changed it.

A camp blueprint that drops from Rath’mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron. It lets Alchemists with 140 skill make a Fermenter: placed at camp, it makes some reagents and works as a Mana Well. No hotfix has changed it.
No hotfix has changed it. Blizzard’s hotfix list, up to its 13 Nov notes, doesn’t mention it, and nor does any Blizzard post since.

Blizzard hasn’t changed its drop rate: no hotfix up to 12 Nov mentions it. It drops from water elementals in Felwood and the Eastern Plaguelands, at levels 53 to 58, so more get listed as players reach them. Forever’s new Leatherworking Living Crown takes 20 at a time.
No hotfix or news explains the jump. Forever’s new Leatherworking crafts use it in bulk: the Living Crown takes 20.
A rare drop (Fenros in Duskwood, 0.2%), so few are listed and its price jumps around. In Forever it teaches Draught of Detect Lesser Invisibility, from Alchemy 195. No hotfix has changed it.
